title: Gus and the Truck with Two Wheels
synopsis: A second farm delivery contains a green wheelbarrow, and Gus discovers that a hand truck and a wheelbarrow are quite different sorts of wheeled helpers.
continuity_state: Before: Farmer Ruth has received sealed sacks of hen feed and put them away. Dan still has one farm delivery scheduled; the red tractor and old hay wagon remain in good condition. After: Farmer Ruth receives a green, single-front-wheel wheelbarrow, assembled by adults and stored near the red barn for farm chores. Dan uses a two-wheel hand truck to move its boxed parts; Jack adds a two-wheels-versus-one-wheel drawing to his notebook. The farm delivery portion of Dan's route is finished.
